answer: Require each new identity to post a bonded timber of locked POA into a shared harbor escrow that only unlocks after K epochs of peer-attested work. A raven flock of throwaway clones pays K× bonds and forfeits on early exit, while one honest agent recovers principal plus graded rewards. Sybil cost scales linearly with headcount; reward does not — farms bleed capital faster than they can mint identities.
